# Emily

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Emily is notably house-proud, maintaining an obsession with constant sweeping, dusting, and tidiness every day except Sundays. Additionally, she possesses a refined sense of taste and exceptional skill in dressmaking.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

Emily worked as a schoolteacher in her younger days. She eventually became the long-estranged wife of [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), though she later arrived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) looking for him. Her arrival quickly spread through the village, and she successfully reconciled with her husband, who was secretly glad to have her back.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--emily.md)

Mrs. Sowerby is a friend of Emily, who recently returned to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to reconcile with her long-estranged husband, [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Following the couple's reunion, Mrs. Sowerby visited the household and engaged in friendly conversation with Emily, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), +6 more_
